name: Volaren Inc.
long_description:
Every great investment starts as an idea about the world. Institutions have teams of analysts turning those ideas into positions. Volaren is that team, processing data through fundamentals and quantitative models that can be personalized with AI.

Turn your views into trades, portfolios, and back-testable frameworks and strategies, and Volaren stays with you from there, showing you what's actually driving each position and what it means for your next move.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Founder at Volaren Inc. Previously signal researcher on the Equity Alpha team at Goldman Sachs Asset Management. Developed alternative risk metrics and supported trading at Low Tide Capital Management. One of the first team members at David Protein, pre-launch, working on growth primarily. Studying Statistics and Economics at UChicago (top 5% of class). 2nd in international economics competition in high school.
